lines.zh: 我四条腿拖着走，声音很轻。
lines.en: I drag along on four legs, quietly.
I lie in the mud and inch forward.
One swing of my tail moves the mud.
On land I move clumsily.

lines.zh: 我沿着水边长草的地方走。
lines.en: I keep to the reedy bank.
I slide my belly through the mud.
I know this swamp.
I cross sideways, slowly.
There is moss on my back.

lines.zh: 水从我的鳞缝里往下淌。
lines.en: Water runs down between my scales.
And slide back down.
I crush through the lilies.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可没人敢挡。
lines.en: I am slow. No one blocks me.
My claws sink into soft mud.
I climb along a fallen log.
The moss on my back is warm and sticky.
Mud cakes my back.
Weeds tangled on my tail.
One eye half open.
Mud seeps slowly beneath my belly.
The water lies flat and bright.
I hear insects.
My upper jaw stays open.
This mud is mine.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔，泡了二十分钟。
lines.en: My back moss took twenty minutes to grow.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔又长了一点。
lines.en: More moss has grown on my back.
The water is warm.

lines.zh: 这一下只是警告，你退两步。
lines.en: That was only a warning — back two steps.
I open my mouth for you to see.

lines.zh: 这一下只是警告，沼泽里我还没张嘴。
lines.en: This was only a warning; I have not opened my jaws.
Two steps back.
My jaws close fast.
The water's edge is mine.
You are on my mud.
You are quite dry.
We have held each other's gaze a while.
I whip my head around.
That struck my tail.
I roll into the mud, tail slapping water.
Soaking long, moss grew on my back.
I open my mouth and back away.
Blood mixes into the mud.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥里，背上还挂着水草。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with waterweed on my back.

lines.zh: 疼……我得去找点吃的疗伤。
lines.en: That hurt. I need to find food to heal.
Is that meat?
I am not fussy.
I drag the meat into the shallows.

lines.zh: 九种颜色都饿，这点不够。
lines.en: All nine of my colors are hungry, this is not enough.
Do you have more meat on you?

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我泡出了苔。
lines.en: Moss grows on me from the swamp mud.
The smell of blood opens my jaws wide.
Smells like meat... and I'm still hungry.
My tail lashed you.

lines.zh: 沼泽里泡久了，背上长苔。
lines.en: Soaked long in the swamp, moss grows on my back.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我只抬了抬头。
lines.en: You bumped me and I only lifted my head.
The mud is churned up.
I only shifted position.
My scales take the step with a dull thud.
Move out of the way.
Don't step into my swamp.
These two by the water are a pair.
It is shorter and fatter.
We lie in the mud together.
It opens its mouth. I close mine.
The clutch is buried in the sand.
We take turns guarding.
If the water rises, we move.
It goes into the water first.
I stay on the bank.
Something is floating.
I test its weight on my teeth.
It is heavier than I am.
I drag it onto the bank.
I hold it at the side of my jaw.
I drag it into the water.

lines.zh: 这块肉掉在水边，归我了。
lines.en: This meat fell by the water — mine now.

lines.zh: 水里的东西，我都捡得起来。
lines.en: Anything in the water, I can scoop up.
Something moved.
Mouth open, that's your warning.
My snout lifts, all teeth bared.
A strip of my back breaks the water.
I hold still and let it come.
My tail is braced.
I am ready to bite.
The moment is right.
My jaws close.
Half a step back puts me in the water.
It will fall back into the water.
My belly presses into the mud.
I wait for you to step into the mud.
You stepped in.
I close my mouth and hold still.

lines.zh: 你盯着我时，我已经张嘴了。
lines.en: While you stare, my jaws are already open.

lines.zh: 再看我一眼，我就当你在挑衅。
lines.en: One more look and I'll call it a challenge.
I roll and drag it into the water.
My teeth sink in.
I bite down and roll toward the water.
Mud splashes my eyes.
It stopped.
I let go, slowly.
Once I bite, you won't be running.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥会拖住你的脚步。
lines.en: The swamp mud will drag your steps down.
This swamp suits me.
The reeds hide me.
Water still runs off my back.
The sun is warm.
There are frogs here.
I shift into the mud.
I lift my eyes from under the duckweed.
I am not interested.
Fire scorched my back.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下去，肚子先着地。
lines.en: I fell off the bank on my belly.
The mud under the water pulls me down.
Something stuck in my back.
My jaw has locked up.
There is too little to eat here.

lines.zh: 雷打在水上，我一动不动。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I go still.

lines.zh: 没有泥的鳄鱼，皮都干裂。
lines.en: A crocodile without mud cracks all over.
